name: rome
place: A narrow street in ancient Rome at noon: tall ochre apartment buildings with wooden balconies on both sides, a bakery counter with round loaves on the left, a stone fountain on the right, the Colosseum at the far end of the street, paving stones.

baker.look: A Roman baker as people picture ancient Romans: a plump man in a simple off-white tunic with a rope belt and a flour-dusted apron, leather sandals.
baker.face: He has a fleshy face, small close-set black eyes, thick arched eyebrows, a short broad nose, a double chin, a bald head with grey hair at the sides.

legionary.look: A Roman legionary as people picture Roman soldiers: a red tunic, segmented steel armour, a steel helmet with cheek guards, a red rectangular shield on his back, a short sword at his hip.
legionary.face: He has a narrow gaunt face, sharp pale green eyes, thin straight eyebrows, a long thin nose, a pointed jaw with stubble and a crooked smirk.

shots.desc: A narrow street in ancient Rome at noon: tall ochre apartment buildings with wooden balconies on both sides, a bakery counter with round loaves on the left, a stone fountain on the right, the Colosseum at the far end of the street, paving stones. Wide shot at eye level down the street. A Roman baker as people picture ancient Romans: a plump man in a simple off-white tunic with a rope belt and a flour-dusted apron, leather sandals. He has a fleshy face, small close-set black eyes, thick arched eyebrows, a short broad nose, a double chin, a bald head with grey hair at the sides. He stands behind the bakery counter on the left. A Roman legionary as people picture Roman soldiers: a red tunic, segmented steel armour, a steel helmet with cheek guards, a red rectangular shield on his back, a short sword at his hip. He has a narrow gaunt face, sharp pale green eyes, thin straight eyebrows, a long thin nose, a pointed jaw with stubble and a crooked smirk. He walks up to the counter from the right.
shots.layout: The camera looks down the street towards the Colosseum; the bakery is on the left, the fountain on the right; the sun is high.
